(2) Given circle O_2: x^2 + y^2 - 8y = 0, find the equation(s) of the circle(s) whose center lies on x - y - 2 = 0 and which pass through the intersection point(s) of circle O_2 and curve C;

(3) Through point A draw a line l which meets curve C at points M and N. Let D(5,0). Find the maximum possible area of triangle DMN.

$\overrightarrow{PA}=(-1-x,-y)$

$\overrightarrow{PB}=(9-x,y)$

Because $\lvert\overrightarrow{PB}\rvert^2+\lvert\overrightarrow{PA}\rvert^2=82$,
therefore $(x-4)^2+y^2=25$.

(3) $y=k(x+1)$.

Rearranging gives
